hook.name: SqueezeCurveMainnetTaxHook
hook.description: An ERC-20 token ("squeeze curve" / "sc") combined with a Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 2% swap tax on every trade. In afterSwap, the hook takes the tax from the unspecified-token side of the swap via poolManager.take() and sends it to an immutable taxRecipient address, returning the fee amount as an afterSwap delta.
